g.title: public.users
g.text: People who can sign in. Not org-owned (no RLS); anonymised on account deletion.

g.title: public.organizations
g.text: A landlord's organisation. Readable in its own context, by its members and by admin; updated only by its landlord or admin.

g.title: public.memberships
g.text: A user's role in one org. Exactly one active landlord per org.

g.title: public.caretaker_buildings
g.text: Which buildings a caretaker membership may act on.

g.title: public.buildings
g.text: A building with its billing calendar and late-fee rule.

g.title: public.leases
g.text: A tenancy of one unit. One live (pending/active/notice) lease per unit.

g.title: public.units
g.text: A rentable flat, room or shop in a building.

g.title: public.unit_charges
g.text: Fixed monthly charges of a unit (service, water, gas...).

g.title: public.lease_tenants
g.text: Tenant memberships on a lease; one primary.

g.title: public.lease_charges
g.text: Fixed charges copied from the unit at lease start.

g.title: public.deposit_entries
g.text: Deposit ledger (received, refunded, applied to dues).

g.title: public.bills
g.text: One bill per lease and month. total = sum of lines, paid = sum of allocations.

g.title: public.bill_lines
g.text: History. Rent, charges, electricity, adjustments, at most one late fee.

g.title: public.payments
g.text: History (void, never delete). Cash, bKash, Nagad, bank, SSLCommerz.

g.title: public.files
g.text: Private stored objects (Cloudinary authenticated / local driver).

g.title: public.payment_allocations
g.text: History. How a payment is spread over bills.

g.title: public.payment_intents
g.text: SSLCommerz sessions; only the validated IPN or the re-check job changes them.

g.title: public.receipt_counters
g.text: Gapless receipt sequence per org and year.

g.title: public.receipts
g.text: History. One receipt per payment, numbered BM-YYYY-NNNNNN.

g.title: public.maintenance_requests
g.text: Tenant repair requests and their state.

g.title: public.notification_preferences
g.text: Per user, type and channel opt-outs.

g.title: public.push_subscriptions
g.text: Web Push endpoints of a user's devices.

g.title: public.outbox
g.text: Notification delivery queue. bm_app may only insert; the worker delivers.

g.title: public.job_runs
g.text: Worker job history for the admin health screen.

g.title: public.admin_org_overview
g.text: Admin view. Orgs with counts; rows only when app.is_admin = 'true'.

g.title: public.admin_health
g.text: Admin view. Job runs, failed outbox, flagged/stuck intents; admin context only.
